title: os-dev contract: the force-push twin defers to the LANDING repository's AGENTS.md §3 — objectui and cloud forbid absolutely, objectstack allows five-criteria `--force-with-lease` (objectui#9666 ruling C)
body:
Filed by the director seat (objectstack #12708, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`) executing decision batch #152 item 2 — maintainer 「其他同意」 to **C** on objectui#9666.

## The rule

A force-push is governed by the `AGENTS.md` of the repository the branch lives in. objectstack `AGENTS.md` §3 permits `--force-with-lease` on a provably unshared `claude/issue-*` branch under five criteria (maintainer ruling 2026-09-10 on #16851, landed by #17398); objectui `AGENTS.md:316` and cloud `AGENTS.md:63` forbid it absolutely — objectui refuses the single-user exception by name. Both texts stand. The near-miss that produced the ruling: an objectui PM seat carried objectstack's allowance into objectui and instructed a dev to amend + force-push; only the dev's refusal (objectui#9492 `5711825596`) kept history intact.

## Ask (objectstack half — the objectui sentence is objectui#9666's)

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`'s force-push line, which today defers to 「§3」 (objectstack's), is re-pointed at **the landing repository's** `AGENTS.md` §3, with one clause naming the two shapes (absolute ban in objectui / cloud; five criteria in objectstack) so a dev working a sibling repo does not resolve 「§3」 to the wrong file.
- Governed surface (`.claude/agents/**`) ⇒ human merge by the approver. `Clause-②: no`; `skip-changeset`.
